'''Virtual Legacy''' is the [[Players Committee]] Virtual-card era from the [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]] to the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]]. It is packaged as [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1&ndash;9]] and Legacy [[Virtual Shields]]. The full constructed pool is [[Legacy Open]].

== Sets ==

The 2009 reorganization grouped earlier numbered Virtual Sets into six thematic Blocks.<ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (official text as of 7 December 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Blocks 7&ndash;9 are later expansions. Set index: [[Virtual Blocks (2009-2014)]]. Event page: [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]. Tiles: [[Main Page#Virtual Legacy (2009–2014)|Main Page]].

== Organized play ==

Championship constructed used this Block pool through the [[2014 World Championship]] in Toronto.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210624200645/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The same Toronto weekend ran a [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]] in the post-Reset [[Open]] pool, won by [[Keith Brown]].<ref name="list">[[List of SWCCG tournaments]]</ref>

== Online play ==

[[Holotable]] remained the downloaded tabletop through this era.<ref name="c1ght">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/holotable-playing-star-wars-ccg-online-the-setup/ Holotable - Playing Star Wars CCG Online - The Setup], Category One Games. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220926090936/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/holotable-playing-star-wars-ccg-online-the-setup/ Internet Archive]</ref> [[GEMP]] came later.

== Rules ==

The era's rules book is [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]]. That book introduced the [[Mission]] card type.

== End of the era ==

The [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]] cut the competitive virtual pool. Pre-Reset Blocks remain [[Legacy Open]]. Current numbering is the [[Virtual Modern]] era.
